name: Google
overview: Search, cloud, ads and consumer products at very large scale. Software engineering interviews are known for algorithmic depth.

interview_process.description: Background, role fit and logistics.
Typically one or two coding interviews in a shared editor.
Usually several coding interviews, a system design interview for experienced candidates, and a behavioral interview on Googleyness and leadership.
Interview feedback is reviewed by a committee; team matching often follows.

tips: Talk through your approach and its complexity before coding; interviewers grade the reasoning, not just the result.
Expect follow-ups that change constraints; practise adapting a working solution.
Write clean code without an IDE's help.

name: Amazon
overview: E-commerce, AWS and devices. Every interview round also assesses the Leadership Principles.

interview_process.description: Commonly coding problems plus a work-style survey for early-career roles.
Coding and Leadership Principle questions.
Several interviews mixing coding, system design (for experienced roles) and behavioral questions; one interviewer is often a 'Bar Raiser' from outside the team.

behavioral_values: Strive to be Earth's Best Employer
Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
tips: Prepare two or three STAR stories per Leadership Principle, with measurable results.
Behavioral questions carry real weight in every round, not just one.
Use 'I', not 'we': interviewers want your own actions.

name: Microsoft
overview: Cloud (Azure), productivity software, developer tools and gaming.

interview_process.description: Background and role fit.
Typically a coding interview.
Several interviews covering coding, design and behavioral questions; teams vary in format.

tips: Show how you learn from mistakes: growth mindset is a stated value.
Clarify requirements and test your code with examples out loud.

name: Meta
overview: Social apps (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp) and VR/AI research, at massive scale.

interview_process.description: Background and logistics.
Usually coding problems under time pressure.
Typically two coding interviews, a system or product design interview for experienced candidates, and a behavioral interview.

behavioral_values: Be direct and respect your colleagues
tips: Coding rounds often expect two problems in one interview: practise speed as well as correctness.
In behavioral answers, emphasise impact and how you handled disagreement.

name: Apple
overview: Hardware, operating systems and services. Hiring is largely team-driven, so the process varies by team.

interview_process.description: Role fit and experience.
Coding and domain-specific questions set by the team.
Several interviews with the team, often deep on your past projects.

tips: Know your past projects in depth: expect detailed questions about your decisions.
Research the specific team's product area.

name: Netflix
overview: Streaming at global scale. Hiring leans towards experienced engineers; culture fit is assessed explicitly.

interview_process.description: Experience, role fit and culture.
Coding and system design, often tied to real problems the team has.
Several technical and culture interviews.

tips: Read the Netflix culture memo and prepare examples that show judgement and candor.
Expect system design grounded in scale and reliability.

name: Uber
overview: Ride-hailing, delivery and logistics platforms with real-time, location-heavy systems.

interview_process.description: Background and role fit.
Typically a coding interview.
Coding, system design for experienced candidates, and behavioral interviews.

tips: System design questions often involve real-time location, matching or payments.
Be ready to discuss trade-offs of consistency versus availability.

name: Flipkart
overview: One of India's largest e-commerce companies.

interview_process.description: Commonly coding problems.
Commonly reported: build a small working system (clean, extensible code) in a fixed time.
Data structures and algorithms.
System design for experienced roles, then fit and past work.

tips: Practise machine coding: design classes cleanly, keep it extensible, and get it running within the time limit.
Expect strong emphasis on DSA fundamentals.

name: Atlassian
overview: Team collaboration software (Jira, Confluence, Trello). Values are assessed in a dedicated interview.

interview_process.description: Background and role fit.
Coding (often practical, code-quality focused) and system design for experienced roles.
Behavioral questions mapped to the company values.
Past work, growth and collaboration.

tips: Prepare a story for each company value; the values interview is a real gate.
Write readable, well-structured code: quality is weighed alongside correctness.

name: Goldman Sachs
overview: Investment bank with large engineering teams building trading, risk and platform systems.

interview_process.description: Commonly coding problems, sometimes with aptitude questions.
Coding in a shared editor, data structures, and core CS fundamentals.
Several back-to-back technical and behavioral interviews.

tips: Revise CS fundamentals (OOP, DBMS, OS) as well as DSA.
Expect questions on why finance and why this firm.
